description: Enumerate all sites in the Stack Exchange network — name, api_site_parameter, audience, and URL. The api_site_parameter value is what other tools accept as the `site` input (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "serverfault"). Results are fetched live and optionally filtered by name. Use this tool to discover valid site parameters before calling other stackexchange_* tools.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive name filter — returns only sites whose name contains all provided tokens. Omit to return all sites.

name: stackexchange_list_sites

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `quota_exceeded`: The Stack Exchange API quota_remaining reached 0 during the site page walk. `invalid_parameter`: Stack Exchange rejected a parameter of the /sites request and named the field. `invalid_api_key`: Stack Exchange does not recognize the API key this server is configured with. `upstream_unavailable`: Stack Exchange answered with a body that is not the expected JSON envelope. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Actionable guidance when results are empty or filtered.

quotaMax.description: Maximum API quota calls per day (300 keyless, ~10,000 with API key).

quotaRemaining.description: Remaining API quota calls for the current day.

sites.description: Stack Exchange network sites matching the optional name filter.

items.description: A Stack Exchange network site entry.

apiSiteParameter.description: Value to pass as the `site` parameter on all other stackexchange_* tools (e.g. "stackoverflow").

audience.description: Intended audience description when provided by the API.

totalCount.description: Total number of sites returned after filtering.

title: List Stack Exchange Sites
